sections.title: Home, by way of <a1>everywhere.</a1>
sections.sub: West LA to UCLA, USC, and UCSF — and back to the streets he started on.
paras: Jonathan Shadi grew up in West Los Angeles. Today he operates a few miles from where he was raised.

The path out and back ran through some of California's most demanding programs — a neuroscience degree with College Honors at UCLA, dental school at USC with the John Ingle Research Award, a surgical internship at the VA in Long Beach serving veterans, and an oral and maxillofacial surgery residency at UCSF-Fresno.
In 2014 he came back to Greater Los Angeles to practice. Twelve years later, the patients his colleagues send him cross the city to sit in his chair.
